description: She wears a floor-length teal-blue patterned coat-dress with a fitted structured bodice, low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Broad muted gold woven borders frame the neckline, central front and skirt edges. A matching decorated sash has two circular metal fittings with small hanging ornaments. A cream patterned underdress appears along the lower front and a substantial cream wrap with teal-and-gold woven borders rests around the arms, hanging down each side with fringed ends. A simple gold-toned bracelet is visible. Brown decorated shoes show below the hem. All principal fabrics are opaque, with upper chest exposed but bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis covered. Exact textile fibers are uncertain.
